text:
alex: Heads-up — customer ran an Okta group removal but users still have our `product_admin` role in-app. They say deprovision webhook returned 200, but roles didn't change. Full quote from them pasted below.

maria: can you paste the SCIM logs from their org? specifically PATCH/delete events for groups or users.

alex: paste: `POST /scim/v2/Users 200 OK` then later `PATCH /scim/v2/Groups/{id} 204 No Content` but our audit shows no RoleBinding updates. They mentioned they rotate tokens occasionally.

ashley: common culprit: SCIM token scopes. We accept scoped tokens for SCIM: `scim:read`, `scim:write`, and `groups:manage` (internal). If the token lacks `groups:manage` we accept group PATCH but won't propagate group->role mapping changes. Did Okta push a limited token?

alex: customer says their SCIM integration uses an API token provisioned by their Okta admin via our UI. They rotated it last week.

maria: ask them to run the test push in our UI (Admin → Integrations → SCIM → Test connection) and then capture the full webhook payloads. Also ask them to include the `Authorization: Bearer <token>` header shown. We need to compare scopes in our token records vs what Okta used.

devops-bot: token-lookup: token_id=tok_4f2a; scopes=["scim:read","scim:write"] ; issued_at=2026-12-05T04:12:23Z

ashley: that confirms it — token missing `groups:manage`. When Okta removes group membership it still PATCHes the Group object, but our syncer only updates internal RoleBindings when the token used has the `groups:manage` capability (safety check). Without it we accept the SCIM change but skip downstream role propagation.

alex: ugh. customer didn't realize we require explicit group scope. Can we surface clearer error? Right now we return 200 on group PATCH to be idempotent for Okta, but maybe we should include a warning header when scope insufficient.

maria: short-term: tell customer to create a new SCIM token with all required scopes and re-run a full resync (Admin → SCIM → Force full sync). They may need to trigger a user deprovision/reprovision for dangling roles depending on timing.

ashley: sample repro steps to send customer:
1) Create new token via Settings → API keys (ensure `groups:manage` present)
2) In Okta, update SCIM connector to use the new token
3) In our Console run `Force full SCIM sync` and monitor Audit → SCIM events
4) Verify RoleBindings table shows group->role detaches

alex: paste customer-facing snippet for support doc:
```
If users remain after group deletion, your SCIM token probably lacks the group management scope. Rotate the token and include groups:manage, then trigger a full SCIM sync.
```

maria: long-term: file an internal ticket to add a warning header on group operations when token scope insufficient, and add a UI check when generating SCIM tokens to show required scopes for group mappings.

ashley: I've sent the repro steps and asked them to confirm after rotating token. Also suggested they run `GET /scim/v2/Groups/{id}` before and after to see member list changes.

devops-bot: ticket-created: CS-9876 — "SCIM: warn on group operations when token scope omits groups:manage"

alex: customer replied: "rotated token, forced sync — roles cleared as expected. thanks!" :party_parrot:

maria: marking as resolved but will link CS-9876 to roadmap for the header/UI improvement.

ashley: closing loop with comms template sent to customer: short explanation + pointer to docs.

alex: thanks all. keeping this thread for the audit trail.
